home.titulo: I build systems where the business rule is the hard problem.
home.entrada1: What breaks a system is rarely the technology. It's the rule nobody wrote down in full: what happens when the review day falls on a public holiday, what an hour worked at three in the morning on a Sunday is worth, what happens when two people book the same slot at the same time.
home.entrada2: That's the work. The systems below are in production with real users, and each one keeps a record of why it's built the way it is.
home.camino1Texto: Full-stack development, with independent judgement and decisions I can argue for. Available for full-time roles.
home.camino2Texto: A system that solves one concrete problem in your business, built to last and documented so somebody else can pick it up.
home.camino3Texto: Software that's already built and running, rented monthly. Today: booking for barbershops.

trabajo.entrada: Six systems, each with its problem, its hard decision, and the trail to verify it. Everything else is further down.
trabajo.archivoEntrada: Smaller projects, delivered proposals and things still under construction. No long case, but here they are.

servicios.entrada: I build systems for businesses that already understand their problem and need someone to solve it properly.

productos.entrada: Software that already exists, already works and already has people using it. Rented monthly, with no development in between.

contacto.entrada: Email is fastest. I reply within one business day.
contacto.queIncluir: If it's about a project, it helps to tell me what problem you want solved and by when. You don't need to know how it gets solved — that's my part.
